The '''Notsub Shipping Company corporate headquarters''' was the central headquarters for the [[Notsub Shipping Company]], owned by [[Armanda Durkin]]. It was located on the northern edge of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GG7" />
